messages:
sarah: Heads-up 0 min: I'm putting up a docs draft for a 'split-signing proxy' pattern for on-prem/private installs. Goal: let site ops keep HSMs in a secure subnet while a small proxy in a semi-trusted zone handles API-level signing requests. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4399

tom: Love it. Two quick asks: 1) can we add a short schematic (installer -> proxy -> hsm) with explicit CIDR examples? 2) include a minimal terraform example for the proxy SG?

anika: Agree. Also add a clear threat-model callout: the proxy does not store keys and only relays sign requests; all private key ops happen inside the HSM. Mention recommended audit fields (x-trace-id, user-id, operation).

jeff: For UX, include a small preflight script folks can run from the installer host. Something like:

```
# quick preflight from installer host
nc -zv proxy.example.com 8443 || echo "proxy unreachable"
curl --cacert proxy-ca.pem https://proxy.example.com:8443/v1/ping | jq .status
```

sarah: Good. I'll add that. Planning to include an example systemd unit for the proxy and a tiny healthcheck path that returns both proxy and HSM status.

anika: Security nit: show an example rotation flow for the short-lived token used between app -> proxy. Recommend 5m TTL and a refresh endpoint that requires client cert + otp.

jeff: Can we add a Python example for apps that want to call the proxy? People often ask for non-node examples. Something like requests + mTLS: 

```
import requests
resp = requests.post(
  'https://proxy.example.com:8443/v1/sign',
  data=b'important',
  headers={'Authorization':'Bearer shorttoken','x-trace-id':'t-'+str(int(time.time()))},
  cert=('/etc/ssl/certs/client.pem','/etc/ssl/private/client.key'),
  verify='/etc/ssl/certs/proxy-ca.pem'
)
print(resp.status_code, resp.text)
```

anika: Perfect. Also add a small terraform SG snippet to the networking appendix: 

```
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "installer_to_proxy" {
  type              = "ingress"
  from_port         = 8443
  to_port           = 8443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = [var.installer_cidr]
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.proxy.id
}
```

tom: For offline customers, include instructions to package the proxy CA and a rotated token into the airgap bundle. Call out maximum file sizes (we used to have a CLI limit at 6kb) and link to the bug if that affects them.

sarah: I'll flag the size limit in a troubleshooting note. I'll also add a sample troubleshooting table with common errors (tls handshake fails, ping returns 502 proxy->hsm, token expired).

jeff: FYI I noticed a small installer issue earlier: if client cert chain includes an extra intermediate cert the installer cert parser warns but continues. Might be worth a footnote. I'll open a tiny issue and add the link.

anika: Let's also provide a fallback: if the proxy cannot reach the HSM, the proxy should return a 503 with a structured body { "error":"hsm-unavailable", "retry_after":30 } so installers can handle it.

sarah: Good call. I'll standardize the health endpoints: /v1/health (checks local svc) and /v1/hsm (proxied HSM status). Also add a short section on metrics exposed (sign_count, last_hsm_latency_ms, failed_signs).

tom: Who can review? I can take network + ops.

anika: I'll review security + wording tomorrow after lunch.

jeff: I'll add the systemd fragment and the terraform SG to the PR.

dev-ops-bot: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4399 1 files changed. reviewers: @tom @anika @jeff

sarah: Thanks all 1 I'll iter on the examples and merge once we have the bug links and one security review.
